id: French - Intermediate 4-Wellington High School, 249 Taranaki Street, Te Aro, Wellington-Wellington High School
name: French - Intermediate 4
venue: Wellington High School, 249 Taranaki Street, Te Aro, Wellington
long_description:
For those who have completed our French Intermediate 3 course or equivalent (approx 110 hours of French learning).  The course will focus on developing conversation skills.
For people who already know the basics vocabulary and grammar points and want to improve their conversational and fluency skills.  
Expected course outcomes:
1. revisit language structures, grammar and vocabulary previously studied
2. discuss new topics such as media, environment, work, education (students are encouraged to suggest topics of general interest)
3. explore new grammar points (the pluperfect, present and past conditional, "if" clause, the subjunctive)
4. continue working on pronunciation and development of conversational skills.
Note:  Courses need a minimum number to go ahead so if we don't have enough enrolments a few days before the start date, we have to cancel. We'll let you know by email so please check yours regularly. If you need to cancel your registration, here are our terms and conditions: "What You Need to Know".

id: Cooking - Flavours of Vietnam-Wellington High School, 249 Taranaki Street, Te Aro, Wellington-Wellington High School
name: Cooking - Flavours of Vietnam
venue: Wellington High School, 249 Taranaki Street, Te Aro, Wellington
long_description:
Explore authentic Vietnamese recipes and create your own classic Vietnamese flavours. In this one-day workshop you’ll make the “big four”:
beef phở,
spring rolls on noodle salad,
traditional banhmi,
coconut jelly
 All ingredients provided but bring an apron, tea towels and a dish cloth and containers to take any leftovers home.
You’ll leave this workshop with:
 -          Tips to cook your favourite Vietnamese dishes in the quick and easy way
-          Essential Vietnamese cooking techniques and kitchen tips
-          How to adapt recipes to suit your family's tastes and dietary preferences
-          Where to source authentic ingredients in Wellington
-          Cultural stories and traditions behind Vietnamese food
-          Opportunities to connect with others through a shared cooking and dining experience
-          Take-home recipes to recreate the dishes with confidence
Note:  Courses need a minimum number to go ahead so if we don't have enough enrolments a few days before the start date, we have to cancel. We'll let you know by email so please check yours regularly. If you need to cancel your registration, here are our terms and conditions: "What You Need to Know".

id: Yoga - All Levels-Wellington High School, 249 Taranaki Street, Te Aro, Wellington-Wellington High School
name: Yoga - All Levels
venue: Wellington High School, 249 Taranaki Street, Te Aro, Wellington
long_description:
Yoga - All Levels
Do you want to try yoga in a safe and friendly environment or do you already do yoga and want to learn more?  Classes are designed to cater to all levels.
Yoga is life-time learning and each will develop according to their own needs and readiness to participate.  Additional possible outcomes include improved breathing, ability to relax, better sleep, more flexibility, strength, energy and improved posture.
By the end of the course you will:
do basic yoga postures with more confidence
refine your performance of yoga postures by learning some of the physiology involved
do some yoga breathing techniques
do a range of warm-up and stretching exercises.
have gained self-awareness of tension levels, breathing and posture
have improved your ability to relax, using basic relaxation techniques                      
Bring a yoga mat and a bottle of water.
 (This is a physical activity that involves an element of risk. While all possible measures are taken to prevent accidents or injury, please note that participation is at your own risk).
Note:  Courses need a minimum number to go ahead so if we don't have enough enrolments a few days before the start date, we have to cancel. We'll let you know by email so please check yours regularly. If you need to cancel your registration, here are our terms and conditions: "What You Need to Know".
